name: Score n8n community job posts with Google Gemini and send alerts to Telegram

parameters.content:
## AI job alerts from the n8n community forum (Telegram + Google Sheets)

### How it works

Every 15 minutes the workflow reads the RSS feed of the n8n community **Jobs** category (works with any Discourse or RSS feed). New posts are compared against a "seen" sheet so each post is rated only once. Google Gemini decides whether a post is a real client request or freelancer self-promotion and scores it from 1 to 10 against your profile. Good matches are sent to Telegram, and every rated post is logged to Google Sheets.

### Setup steps

- Create a Google Sheet with two tabs: `seen` (columns `id`, `date`) and `log` (columns `date`, `score`, `isRequest`, `type`, `language`, `summary`, `title`, `link`).
- Select that sheet in **Read seen post IDs**, **Mark posts as seen** and **Log every rated post** (Google Sheets credential).
- Add a **Google Gemini (PaLM) API** credential (key from aistudio.google.com) in **Score post with Gemini**.
- In **Send Telegram alert**, add your Telegram bot credential and enter your chat ID.
- Edit `MY_PROFILE` and `PREFERRED_LANGUAGE` in **Build AI request**, then activate.

### Customization

Change the feed URL in **Fetch jobs RSS feed**, the scoring rules in **Build AI request**, or the minimum score (default 5) in **Good match?**.

## 1. Fetch new posts
Reads the IDs already processed, reads the RSS feed and keeps only posts that were not rated before.

## 2. Rate with AI
Stores the new IDs first (so a post is never rated twice), then asks Gemini for a JSON rating. Batching sends one request every 7 seconds to stay inside free-tier limits.

## 3. Alert & log
Score >= 5 and a real client request: Telegram alert. Every rated post goes to the log sheet.
